Part of the Locked On Podcast Network.

programme.title: Eastmans' Conservation Films
programme.desc: The killer winter of 2022-2023 almost wiped out the famous Wyoming Range mule deer herd. Only 5,000 deer survived the brutal conditions. Join Ike Eastman in 2025 to explore how this population is faring today. Migration is one key to the survival of this mule deer herd. There is hope. Actions we can take today including fence improvements, habitat restoration and more have been proven to make a difference to the survival of these deer and other wildlife. Ongoing migration research is setting the standard for mule deer conservation across the West.

programme.desc: Marlon Brando directs and stars in One-Eyed Jacks, a gripping Western of betrayal and revenge. As outlaw Rio (Brando) breaks free from prison, he sets his sights on settling the score with his former partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), who double-crossed him years before and now wears the badge of a sheriff. But Rio’s quest for vengeance grows complicated when he falls for Longworth’s spirited daughter, leaving him torn between love and justice. Sweeping vistas, raw emotion, and Brando’s electrifying presence make this a Western unlike any other.

Tracking ruthless outlaws across a frontier steeped in greed and bloodshed, he discovers a web of betrayal that forces him to fight not just for money, but for survival. With stylish shootouts, double-crosses, and the grit of classic Spaghetti Western flair, this tale of vengeance proves that in the West, only the fastest survive.

programme.title: High Sierra Wilderness
programme.desc:
Escape into the High Sierra wilderness, where granite peaks rise above quiet alpine lakes, evening light washes across the mountains, and steam drifts through sunlit pines beside a flowing creek.
Filmed on location by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel, High Sierra Wilderness invites you to slow down and spend time with the beauty of California's Sierra Nevada. Gentle acoustic music, spacious views, and moments of flowing water create a peaceful setting for a quiet break or an unhurried evening at home.
Let your screen become a window into the wilderness. Watch closely, settle in, and enjoy the changing light—or let the scenery bring a sense of mountain calm to your room.
Filmed and produced by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel for NatureStream.tv.
The nature footage is real and was filmed on location; no AI-generated scenery is used. Music generated with Suno AI, then selected, edited, and mixed for NatureStream.tv.
Run time: 1 hour, 44 minutes.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We follow along with the crew from Struttinbuck on their annual Father Son hunt at FE Hill. No matter what happens throughout the year this is always a must have trip and a time to settle down and enjoy the great outdoors.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode of Hunting Land Man, Asa is on a roll. She fills her second and third turkey tags of the year, capping off an incredible season and tagging out in Mississippi. The highlight of the week came when she got to experience her very first double-up with her dad, Slade. Sharing a moment like that in the turkey woods is something they'll never forget, making this a truly unforgettable hunt.

With rods in hand, we explore the river's productive fishing spots, uncovering the best techniques and tips for a successful catch in this transitional season. From scenic backdrops to thrilling strikes, this episode captures the essence of spring fishing at its finest.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Southern California Bluefin Tuna Fishing at Its Finest, Part Two
programme.desc: Today on Stoked On Fishing, we head offshore on the Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot Everglades with an All-Star crew searching for bluefin tuna. We take out Okuma Fishing Tackles President Doug and John, head of product development. We also have on board Colin and his wife, Amanda from Grundens, and our friend Toby from Mag Bay Lures and Mag Bay Resort down in Baja, Mexico. This trip was absolutely nuts, with the best Blue Fin Tuna fishing we have seen in Sothern California all year.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

programme.title: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programme.desc: Jimmie and his best friend Mont try to reclaim the house built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship and sense of belonging in the place they call home.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Elephant human conflict has been going on in India for decades. Only now it has increased because of the shrinking forests and the expanding human habitation. North Bengal with it's fragmented habitat of tea gardens, human habitation and paddy fields is a hot bed of conflict. We follow an elephant flying squad which is responsible for keeping the elephants away from these human dominated landscapes.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: Meet the Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Once marsupials were found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Cape Towns biggest storm in 2 decades, there's a whole lot of work to be done at the Two Oceans Aquarium! The pressure builds as nine Ragged-Toothed Sharks are on their way from East London for their introduction to the new, highly anticipated predator exhibit. Join the team in one last push to complete the giant tank in time for its incoming residents and see the experience the culmination of a year of hard work coming together, at the Two Oceans Aquarium!

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage is home to hundreds of black bears. And it's these black bears, that are patrolling the city. With their brains, their brawn and their cunning, these bears have mastered life in this urban jungle. When Spring arrives the bears hit the city as it's time to start eating. And these bears have found a source of food that is much easier to catch than a slippery salmon - it's trash. And it is everywhere. The city's bins and dumpsters have become the perfect bear restaurant.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise of Nature
programme.desc: The tropical rainforests of Costa Rica provide an invaluable habitat to several emblematic species, such as jaguars, tapirs, white-lipped peccaries, spider monkeys, the very rear green macaw, amongst many others. Most of them are protected in national parks, reserves and wildlife refuges. However, the long-term survival of these ecosystems and of their biodiversity rely on the success of connecting wildlife populations throughout the country.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

programme.title: The Single Moms Club
programme.desc: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate two buildings that may share the same paranormal activity. The client, Grayson owns the 1800's era Rendall Building, which is across the street from the second building with activity, the Caddo Parish Courthouse. They are thought to be connected because it's believed that the The Rendall building's basement once acted as a cold storage facility for those who were hanged at the Courthouse.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab. This building was originally used as a poor house in the late 1800's and became a mental institution in 1915, followed by an animal testing facility. TAPS will have their hands full as they take on claims of threatening shadows and people being physically accosted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Buffalo Naval and Military Park has called upon TAPS to investigate three vessels that all saw gunfire and bloodshed during their time of service. The ships that will be investigated are a cruiser named USS Little Rock (the largest), a destroyer named USS The Sullivans, and a submarine named USS Croaker, (the smallest). USS Little Rock has reported deaths on it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Lucas, Ohio by playwright Mark Jordan to investigate the property on which one of the most gruesome events took place in 1896, The Ceely Rose Murders. Ceely killed her father, brother and lastly, her mother with rat poison because she believed they were keeping her from the love of her life, Guy Berry. Ceely was 23 years at the time, but had a mental capacity of an 8 year old. Mark wrote a play about these murders, which he performs in a barn on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: At the northernmost reaches of the world stretches the largest continuous expanse of vegetation on the planet: the boreal forest. At the boundary between shadow and light, temperatures are extreme, and living beings have adapted to survive. In this vast woodland, the birch tree stands out. Its white bark is a powerful insulator, and its roots, in alliance with symbiotic fungi in the soil, protect it from underground threats.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: At the edge of the boreal forest, where the light shines through, a sacred tree watches over the taiga: the birch. For the people of the Far North, this axis of the world prevents the universe from collapsing.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: In Australia, eucalyptus reigns over a forest where the trees compete in gigantism. For the Aborigines, dating from the time of the dream of their cosmogony, it symbolises the link between Earth and Sky and allows them to communicate with spirits.

programme.title: Of Trees & Forests: The Invisible World
programme.desc: The ceiba tree, the repository of the Wayana people's founding legends, stands majestically above the canopy of the Amazon rainforest. It is a giant that provides a refuge for all living things.

programme.title: Africa's Lost Wilderness - Kenya and the Big Animals
programme.desc: This documentary explores the displacement of lions, elephants and other big game animals from the savannas of Kenya. It is also an intimate depiction of the people who still strive to live in harmony with the natural world.

programme.title: Megeti - Africa's Lost Wolf
programme.desc: The story of the Ethiopian she-wolf Megeti, who lost her pack and is suddenly completely on her own. Since it is essential for the survival of the young wolf to rejoin a pack, she wanders through the Ethiopian highlands in search of a new home.

programme.title: Maasai Mara: Wildlife Crossover
programme.desc: Wildebeest, zebra, antelope and gazelle roam the savannah. The herds, along with their cubs, are seen as the perfect food source for predatory big cats, such as lions, cheetahs and leopards.
programme.sub-title: Maasai Mara, The Big Cats Sanctuary

programme.title: Go Ape
programme.desc: Having a look at different species of primates, how they live, feed and survive, as well as looking at the similarities between apes and humans.

programme.title: Uganda Through the Eyes of a Chimp

programme.title: Survive the Wild

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China III
programme.desc: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

programme.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
programme.desc: Newly released from a mental institution, Ricky (Antonio Banderas) heads straight for a reunion with the love of his life, B-movie actress Marina (Victoria Abril). The trouble is, Marina doesn't remember him -- or the fling they had during her years as a junkie and porn star. Determined to make Marina love him, Ricky barges into her apartment and ties her up. With a captive audience, Ricky is sure it's only a matter of time before his beloved returns his affections.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Idealistic police cadet Chan Wing-Yan (Tony Leung) is recruited by Police Superintendent Wong (Anthony Wong) to go deep undercover as a member of the criminal Triad society. Into the same cadet class, crime boss Hon Sam (Eric Tsang) installs new Triad member Lau Kin Ming (Andy Lau) to become a long-term mole for the gang. A decade later, both have risen through the ranks in their respective aliases -- but when both of their covers are in danger of being blown, a game of life and death ensues.

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
programme.desc: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in China
programme.desc: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until a group of intruders, led by Rose, breaks in. They plan to steal her family's priceless collection of artworks, but their reckless ambition is outmatched only by Rose's opportunism. As the stakes grow even higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: JCVD
programme.desc: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

As Kara's fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time's running out.

Although Anthony is now single, he struggles with how to build a new relationship with a beautiful woman named Tiffany. Anthony is uneasy to love another and he pushes her away. He then finds a letter from his deceased wife, saying that if something happens to her, to love and marry again.

programme.title: Hopetown

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Leverage: Redemption
programme.desc: The crew pulls a con to take down a corrupt tech guru claiming to better the world using effective altruism; they target his company's close-knit group of executives, but things get complicated when the group turns out to be much closer.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Meet Jose Lopez, a man who can forage chicken from deserted farms and cook it, a la Mexican, but also a fighting man. Watch him prove himself, carrying weapons and ammunition through enemy fire, firing his machine gun with deadly accuracy, holding off almost singlehandedly a deadly attack. Watch this Laredo, Texas, born-and-bred soldier earn the nation's highest award and the nickname, 'Tex'.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The American Navy got back on course after Pearl Harbour, and in the four-day Battle for the Coral Sea, they claimed victory, before defeating Japan again in the decisive Battle of Midway. Elsewhere the Luftwaffe targeted more British cities.
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Midway and Beyond: April-June 1942

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler's 'Desert Fox', Rommel advanced at El Alamein, but with the arrival of British General, Bernard Montgomery, to lead the Eighth Army in North Africa, the wind of change was about to blow.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.
programme.sub-title: Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist fiercely. This episode covers the brutal island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns. Japan's refusal to surrender prompts the U.S. to deploy a new and terrifying weapon: the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: A historical record of the 281 days of the 3rd army offensive through France, Belgium and Germany, with air support from the 19th tactical air command.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: By 1942, Soviet industry-rebuilt in the east-fueled the Red Army with mass-produced tanks, planes, and weapons, reversing the tide at Stalingrad. But while the war economy thrived, civilians starved under famine and rationing. With Allied aid and relentless sacrifice, the USSR rose as an industrial giant-at a staggering human cost.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: From the hedgerows of Normandy to the liberation of Paris, this episode retraces the 100 critical days after D-Day. Witness the fierce battles, the resilience of soldiers, and the toll on civilians as the Allies push through German defenses, paving the way for Europe's liberation and altering the course of World War II.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In '1940,' we follow Hitler's trail of occupation into Denmark and Norway, the invasion of Belgium and France & the Miracle Of Dunkirk where Churchill initiated Operation Dynamo to rescue the thousands of BEF that were stranded & helpless on the beaches under relentless Nazi attack. See how Hitler's Blitzkrieg ripped through France and how the British survive The Blitz & win the Battle Of Britain.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Nuclear Test Films
programme.desc: First experimental blast set off in New Mexico; bombing and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Hitler: A Strategy of Failure
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler, considered himself to be the world's greatest military strategist - superior even to Napoleon Bonaparte - and early Blitzkrieg successes could be said to easily confirm this assertion. So why did the Nazis lose the war? Hitler also made colossal strategic military blunders: Dunkirk, Operation Barbarossa and many others that were ultimately a strategy of failure.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Death in the Bunker
programme.desc: Death In The Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall examines the final 10 days in the Berlin Führerbunker deep below the Chancellery of the Reich. Includes interviews with Hitler's confidants and eyewitnesses including Hitler's Secretary Traudl Junge who after typing out Hitler's will, remained in the bunker until his death. Learn firsthand what happened in the bunker right to the very end.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Graphically shown here is the treatment given our wounded in battle. We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Martha Washington Won the War
programme.desc: We all know Martha Washington from her portraits as a dowdy grandmother, but did you know that there is new evidence she was a beautiful and passionate wife befitting her handsome George? And that Martha was the secret weapon that kept troop morale high during the hard winter encampment at Valley Forge? We prepare Martha's authentic Turkey Stew with Oysters and speak with expert Patricia Brady.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 1
programme.desc: We start a special four-part series cooking in Thomas Jefferson's actual kitchen at Monticello, his Virginia home. Chef Staib prepares Jefferson's favorite exotic dish, Stuffed Cabbage with Fried Asparagus. We also tour Jefferson's gardens, where we learn how important discovering and growing foods was to our third President.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 2
programme.desc: In this next episode at Monticello, we learn how Thomas Jefferson "liberated" grains of European rice to grow here in America, and tour his legendary Monticello estate, including the Dependencies that housed the beer and wine cellars, and the ice house. Chef Staib also borrows Jefferson' kitchen to prepare Bouilli, a favorite boiled beef dish of Jefferson's, along with Bouillon Potatoes.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 3
programme.desc: During his years abroad as Minister to France, Jefferson's culinary tastes became refined. In this episode, we get to know James Hemmings, Jefferson's slave cook who accompanied Jefferson to learn the ways of French cuisine. We also meet Jefferson's long-time Monticello cooks, Edith Hern Fossett and Fanny Hern. Chef Staib prepares White Bean and Bacon Soup, Chicken Fricassee, and Herbed Barley.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 4
programme.desc: We end our tour of Jefferson's Gardens at Monticello as we learn how the President carefully cultivated over 330 vegetable varieties, along with a host of fruits. Chef Staib prepares a tour-de-force final meal in Jefferson's kitchen. Curried Lamb and with Rice Pilaf and Stewed Mushrooms, along with Leni Sorensen, Monticello's expert on the slave cooks who worked there.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Ben Franklin's Genius
programme.desc: From discovering how to harness electricity to inventing reading glasses and publishing the first daily newspaper in America, Ben Franklin's genius was a spark that helped to launch a country. We visit the American Philosophical Society, which he founded, to learn more about this most amazing man. Chef Staib prepares Braised Oxtail, and he toasts Franklin with his authentic Spruce Beer.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Washington's Crossing Pepperpot Soup
programme.desc: Before the Christmas night in 1776 when Washington led his troops to a surprise attack on the British at Trenton, he ordered one of their favorite meals to be ready upon their return, Pepperpot Soup with Cornbread. Chef Staib makes this West-Indies influenced dish again, right at that same spot along the Delaware, with revolutionary troops at his side to celebrate that all important victory.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 1
programme.desc: When George Washington wasn't busy governing a fledgling nation, he enjoyed spending time at his family plantation, Mount Vernon. Tour the "Jewel of the Potomac" and join Chef Walter Staib in Washington's very own kitchen as he prepares some of the first President's favorite dishes such as Roasted Beef Marrow, Baked Stuffed Sturgeon, Roasted Root Vegetables and Citrus Vinaigrette.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 2
programme.desc: Meet "Martha Washington" as she brings her years with George to life. Always a gracious hostess, "Martha" invites Chef Walter to tea. We also see the Washingtons' personal china and silverware from Mount Vernon. In the kitchen, Chef Walter's menu includes Pickled Herring Bonne Femme, Roasted Stuffed Grouse, Braised Sunchokes and Sweet Potato Biscuits.

programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke

programme.title: A Life of Ninja
programme.desc: A Kendo teacher (Chen Kuan-Tai) protects a businessman from ninja assassins.

programme.title: Ninja Kill
programme.desc: Purple ninjas are on the rampage and plan to assassinate an important senator and create a puppet state headed by the vixen Miss Littleton. For Gordon, the only way to stop them is to learn their ninja laws and then take on each fighter one by one. And then he still has to contend with Littleton and her acrobatic ninja ladies before the country is secure.

programme.title: Thunder Blade & Lightning Foot
programme.desc: Flash Legs Tan stars as a member of the Foot Clan, whose leader is killed by a mysterious masked swordsman using the Thunder-Blade. Tan sets out on his quest to find the murderer and he enlists the help of the Eagle Claw Clan. Together they un-mask the culprit and bring peace to the martial world once again.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Hai Itto is always a target. Just as he was receiving a request for assassins from Saeki in the precincts of the Ararenji Temple, the Ura Yagyuans, led by Ishine, attacked him with arrows. Itto, who had been cutting down these Yagyuans sent by Yagyu, who were hiding in the form of Unsui, was hit in the chest by an arrow with a poisoned tip, which Ishine had fired. Daigoro tried his best to save Itto, who was still in a coma.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Okei meets Tako in a village haunted be a demon and Tono-sama and Sengoku are recruited to become security enforcers.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 15

programme.title: Duel at Forest aka Duel at the Forest
programme.desc: Pai Lung (Man Kong-Lung) returns home from a prison sentence for accidentally killing the father of his girlfriend Snow (Sally Chen). Upon arriving, he finds that Snow has gotten married to the town's gambling addict an all-around loser Chu Hu. The casino in town is being run by a Westerner (Robameice Deimikor) and his band of thugs that keep things running smoothly.

programme.title: Diamond Ninja Force
programme.desc: Born a Ninja, die a Ninja! A century old feud between the Black Ninja Clan and the Diamond Ninja Empire is on the brink of erupting once again with the discovery of the ancient tomb of the Ninja warriors. Black Ninja descendant, Cogan is determined to defeat the Diamond Ninjas once and for all, but with Gordon of the Diamond Ninjas doing everything to stop him, he is willing to go to hell and back to enlist the Ghost Ninjas to do his evil bidding.

programme.title: Shaolin Iron Claws
programme.desc: Warlords rebel against the government. One chief leaks a secret document to the police. The two brothers discover the power of the document and numerous assassins and warlords are deployed to try to force them to give up the secret.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: While relaxing on their journey, the travelers get caught up in a battle of heirs after a local lord dies.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 4

programme.title: Hell's Wind Staff
programme.desc: Kung fu super villain, Hwang Jang-Lee (known among fans as "Silver Fox,") is the main attraction in this brilliant kung fu flick, which was reportedly adapted from a comic book. Impudent but likeable kung fu students Tiger Wong (Meng Yuen Man) and Stone Dragon (Meng Hoi) have the potential to be great fighters but seem more interested in driving their teachers to distraction.

programme.title: Point the Finger of Death
programme.desc: The story centers on a secret society that plots to overthrow the Qing Dynasty and resume the Ming monarchy. The organization gains the support of numerous righteous martial clans, but the Qing government has its own plans of squashing the rebellion. The scheming prince of Qing poisons the rebels' central figure, Chi Zi Qiang (Jimmy Wang), and uses the antidote to force him to surrender.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai
programme.desc: Iemitsu attempts to solidify the bond between the shogunate and the imperial court by offering his sister to be the consort of the emperor. A series of conspiracies led to the formation of the notorious Ura-yagyu group, led by Jubei.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru
programme.desc: Tako meets a beautiful girl in jail. When they get out, she is attacked by a group of men. Tako and Lord come to her aid, but now must discover why those men were after her.
programme.sub-title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 7

programme.title: Island Art of SILAT
programme.desc: A Journey across Indonesia to explore the relatively undiscovered martial art of Pencak Silat and to reveal the secrets of Silat to a waiting audience worldwide. Historically, technique was passed down from generation to generation within the same bloodline and written records and public demonstrations were rare. "Our Silat was only for our family" says Mas Amien of Chakra Lima. "Before 2007 we never shared our technique.

programme.title: 72 Desperate Rebels
programme.desc: A true classic! An all star cast with untold weapons! The Emperor's spy (Wei Tze-Yung), the daughter of the killed governor Shih Han (Wei Hai-Min), a mysterious mercenary (Wan Shan) and a blind swordsman (Lung Fei) team up to defeat chief pirate (Bai Ying), leader of the 72 Desperate Rebels, but eventually it will be his daughter (Yang Hsiu-Chian) who will decide at the end of the movie. This superb martial arts movie has nice imaginative touches and a very good planning direction.

programme.title: Secret Rivals
programme.desc: A classic kung fu movie! Wong Tao plays Shen Yi Wei, the son of a General, who travels to Gold Valley in Korea, to investigate a gold heist that took place 3 years ago. Shen Yi Wei finds out that the only way that he can get closer to the gang that robbed the gold, is by entering a competition sponsored by the gang leader, who is looking for a top kung fu fighter to become his bodyguard.

programme.desc: Corina alerta a Casillas que su extradición inmediata está aprobada, así que él obliga a Ámbar a ir con la DEA y seguir sus instrucciones.
programme.sub-title: Ámbar debe entregarse a la DEA

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes que Javier lo descubra, Rutila prefiere revelarle que el presidente fue su amante, y su reacción, cae como una bomba que desata una discusión. El Cabo y Evelina recorren los templos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio encierra a Gómez Labrador en una iglesia y le exige que confiese todo sobre la amnistía que propuso. Aunque el candidato se resiste a negociar, le pide un acuerdo con los otros carteles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después del crimen de dos agentes de la DEA, Casillas quiere que Corina abandone la agencia y lo acompañe para pelear contra el mundo. Y a Ámbar le ordena que llame a Colon, para entregarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina le da instrucciones a Ámbar: debe entregar a uno del Cartel de los Soles para distraer a la DEA. Maldonado pide sexo con Casillas como parte de pago. Diana y el Cabo son socios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana Ahumada no quiere seguir con el negocio del narco, pero "El Cabo" la obliga a continuar. Si no lo hace, causará un atentado contra su familia. Javier recuerda cuando conoció a Rutila.
programme.sub-title: El Cabo en guerra con Diana

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pese a las advertencias, Diana Ahumada mata a dos hombres del Cabo y le exige a Ricardo que refuerce la seguridad de su familia. Dona Alba revela que Aurelio podría tener un medio hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Armada hasta los dientes, Diana apunta al Cabo cuando llega con sus hombres y le indica dónde le dejó su última entrega. Arelys rompe en llanto y le cuenta toda la verdad a su jefa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La DEA exige a Ámbar que le entregue a cinco involucrados con la droga del gobierno venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mitón Jiménez va hasta Monclova a asustar a Diana. Amenaza a su familia. LA CIA alerta a la DEA sobre Águila Azul.
programme.sub-title: El cabo se desquita con Diana

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Si no hacen nada para sacar del poder a Terán, Casillas amenaza con liquidar al presidente en una semana. Vinculan la muerte de un senador con Águila Azul. El Cabo y Evelina hacen el amor.
programme.sub-title: Van por Casillas y Águila Azul

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina busca al Rojo tras su excarcelación y lo lleva con los Casillas. Le ofrecen trabajar para ellos. Ismael secuestra al Mocho y a Evelina. Llega Nora Requena a extraditar a Aurelio.
programme.sub-title: El Rojo se une a los Casillas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para acabar con la guerra, Casillas plantea el comercio legal de las drogas a la candidata, Morejón; pero no está dispuesta a negociar. Evelina firma, desconfiada, los papeles al Cabo.
programme.sub-title: Casillas va por la droga legal

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina alerta a Casillas que su extradición inmediata está aprobada, así que él obliga a Ámbar a ir con la DEA y seguir sus instrucciones.
programme.sub-title: Ámbar debe entregarse a la DEA

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al Cabo le soplan la ubicación del Casillas y va por él y por su familia; además, quiere rescatar a Evelina. La CIA sufre una baja.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al mando de un ejército, el Cabo prepara su emboscada para cerrar la cuenta pendiente que tiene con Casillas. El Grenas destapa el pasado oscuro de Evelina, como servidora sexual.
programme.sub-title: El Cabo listo para su revancha

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana le revela a su madre que el verdadero negocio de la familia es el transporte de drogas a EE. UU. Casillas ordena investigar a Zuleta. Maldonado manipula a Navarro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio sostiene que la mejor defensa es el ataque, así que gira instrucciones para conseguir los planos de los Pinos. El sabotaje en la recepción presidencial pone en evidencia a Terán.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Como un francotirador, Casillas mata de un plomazo a Zuleta y le advierte al presidente, que el que juega con fuego, se quema. Ismael tortura al Mocho y Rutila impide que siga haciéndolo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después del bazucazo contra los Casillas y el tiroteo desatado entre los carteles, el Cabo jura hacerle pagar a Aurelio, con la misma moneda: liquidar a su familia. Evelina y el Mocho huyen.
programme.sub-title: Duelo entre Casillas y el Cabo

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando Aurelio cree que mató a su enemigo, El Cabo lo sorprende y le dispara en la cabeza, dejándolo malherido. Aurelio pide ayuda a un viejo amigo. Alba y compañía llegan al Rancho Ahumada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Herido de gravedad, Casillas busca refugio con El Rayo, un viejo amigo de la infancia, que trata de mantenerlo con vida. Rutila, celosa con Kashi.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tal como lo había anunciado, Amado Leal, alias Águila Azul, mata a González, otro exagente y descubre que Colon es aliado de sus enemigos. Casillas está en coma y El Rayo podría entregarlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mientras el presidente y El Cabo quieren a Casillas muerto, la DEA lo busca vivo para hacerle pagar todos sus crímenes, lo extraditarán a EE.UU. Águila Azul va por Colón y el agente lo sabe.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina descubre que atribuyen a Águila Azul, ser cabeza de una organización criminal; pero es falso. Se reencuentran y juntos buscan a Casillas. La DEA fracasa. Garañón y El Cabo son aliados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Águila Azul admite que él y Aurelio son hermanos. El Cabo revisa la lista de gimnasios de boxeo en Tepito.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Milton Jiménez llega con sus hombres y destruye a punta de plomo y fuego el escondite de Casillas, pero termina enfrentándose con Águila Azul. Aurelio empeora, su herida sangra y está infectada.
programme.sub-title: El Cabo enfrenta a Águila Azul

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por una confusión causada por "Alexa", un dispositivo inteligente, Roxana está en problemas y reclama indemnización. El destino de un bosque depende de la decisión de dos hermanos.
programme.sub-title: El brete de Alexa; El peligro del carbón

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lina fue maltratada por su esposo, por eso quiere que su suegra le entregue el dinero de una herencia. La hija de Juanita se quita la vida incitada por una imagen diabólica conocida como Momo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Susana está obsesionada con casarse con un violador y busca uno en la cárcel, pero él se regeneró. José compra un perro para ayudar a su hija deprimida, ahora Gabriela dice que es la dueña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: David le exige a sus empleadas atender a los clientes en ropa interior, ellas lo acusan de acoso sexual. Dos dúos que formaron un cuarteto se enfrentan por dinero y por el nombre artístico.
programme.sub-title: Tanga protesta; Los cuatro a la mitad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roberto no ha logrado superar un trauma de la niñez y por eso afecta la tranquilidad de sus hijos al sobreprotegerlos. El amigo de una tatuadora profesional la mete en problemas con un cártel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jimmy adopta al bebé concebido cuando era heterosexual, pide el divorcio y división de bienes. Maritza le exige 30 mil dólares a Ángel por difamarla en las redes para aumentar su popularidad.
programme.sub-title: Refugio seguro; Falso crimen de odio

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yudy es una bailarina erótica que está cansada de mantener a su esposo, quien trajo a su novia a vivir en la casa. Rafael quiere dejar a su amante por violar las reglas acordadas y embarazarse.
programme.sub-title: Tres strippers y un chulo; Manutención de barriga

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por celos, el hijo de la pareja de Claudia mete al nuevo bebé de la familia en el horno. Ricardo y Alejandro están casados, pero difieren sobre la yegua Jénica y se pelean su custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lilian culpa al esposo de Claudia de profanar el cadáver de su marido para falsificar su identidad, pide compensación. Roxana está embarazada y su novio cree que un hijo contamina el planeta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandro cree que maltrataron a su cuñado en el restaurante de Claudia, donde el chico trabaja, y la demanda. Sonia quiere que Juan José le devuelva su anillo, pero la prenda fue subastada.
programme.sub-title: Discriminación a la vista; Solo cenizas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés no soporta el cambio de su mujer a una vida más saludable y le pide el divorcio. Rubén descubre que su pareja, Pavel, le es infiel y busca compensación por los daños que le ha causado.
programme.sub-title: La gorda fitness; No se hagan los suecos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo descubre que varios hombres lo vigilan y su esposa está detrás de todo. El padre de Lisbeth se quita la vida después de que Carlos, un cazador de pedófilos, lo pilla y graba un video.
programme.sub-title: Perseguido por el pasado; Persiguiendo la verdad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Iván es Drag Queen, contrata a Kevin para que le ayude a ser famosa, pero recibe una orden de deportación. Marta demanda a un prestamista, por las presiones de él, la hija de ella se suicidó.
programme.sub-title: Drag queen abusado; Gota a gota

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roxana exige que Jonathan, el hijo de su pareja, abandone la casa de la cual ella es copropietaria. Además, Julio es un exitoso boxeador, pero es homosexual y nadie lo sabía, reclama respeto.
programme.sub-title: El niño o la casa; Guantes rosados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karina se niega a devolver lo que recaudó para Jayzer cuando su pareja lo violentó, porque ellos volvieron. Julio contacta por redes a una china, pero resultó ser un hombre, exige que se aleje.
programme.sub-title: Porque te amo, te doy; Made in China

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Daniel usa con su novia un juguete sexual en forma de pelota, la madre de ella lo demanda. Dariel y Karla no se ponen de acuerdo, él como donante de esperma quiere reconocer al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hermana de Paola muere de una sobredosis, su pareja de entonces no lo evitó. Alfredo, fanático de los parques temáticos, le roza un seno a una chica sin querer, por eso le prohíben volver.
programme.sub-title: Sexo por fuera; Acoso en el parque

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Laura muere quemado, ella pide 50 mil dólares a su vecina por daños y perjuicios. Un concierto de Bruno fue viral porque se vieron sus genitales, su representante no quiere pagarle.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica quiere el divorcio de Andrés y que la indemnice, la drogó e hizo que la violaran. Carlos exige tratamiento psicológico para su esposa Magdalena, dice que hizo un pacto con el diablo.
programme.sub-title: Me gusta violada; En nombre de Satán

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Kevin quiere divorciarse de Débora porque ella lo maltrata. En otro caso, Chary gana un concurso de belleza trans, pero los organizadores alegan que se equivocaron y le quitan el premio.
programme.sub-title: La acosadora de hombres; La diva destronada

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Patricio pide que la mujer de su padre inhabilitado venda la casa para pagar los gastos médicos. La mamá de Gabriela la envía a terapia para que dejara de ser gay y el terapista la tortura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La persona que le roba su identidad muere, y ahora parece que es ella quien quiere usurpar la identidad de una fallecida. Culpa a la cuidadora por la adicción al celular de su bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Rafael será deportado y pide llevarse a su hijo, quien cambió de sexo, pero la mamá se niega, quiere exponerlo en un reality. Lilian se enferma al comer morcillas hechas con sangrado menstrual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fernando acusa a su madre de permitir que violaran a su hija, le exige una indemnización. July tiene cáncer y es sostén de su familia, su pareja quiere el divorcio y que desaloje de la casa.
programme.sub-title: El silencio; El valor de la vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Chelsy le pide a Helen, la viuda de un bombero, que le entregue parte del dinero que recibió como donación cuando él murió. Vivian busca pareja y encuentra a un hombre con un fetiche muy raro.
programme.sub-title: Donaciones en disputas; Adicto a las manos

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
